First-year applicants

This page is for students applying to enter Eastvale College as first-year undergraduates.

How to apply

Submit your application through the Common Application. First-year applicants should send a school transcript and two teacher recommendations.

Application requirements

The application requirements for first-year applicants are listed below.

Deadlines

The early action application deadline is 1 November 2026 and the regular decision application deadline is 5 January 2027.

Tests and scores

Our standardized testing policy is test-optional for first-year applicants; you may submit the SAT or ACT if you wish.

English language requirements

Applicants whose first language is not English must show English language proficiency with an IELTS minimum overall band of 7.5.

Tuition

For the 2026-27 academic year, tuition for first-year undergraduates is $58,400 per year.
